view.scene_description: A blurry indoor shot of a supermarket aisle filled with colorful instant noodle cups on shelves. A person in a light sweater walks past, partially obscuring the view. Fluorescent lights illuminate the space, and a hot air balloon decoration hangs overhead. Products include branded snacks and beverages.

objects.label: person
objects.observation: A person wearing a light-colored sweater and dark pants walks from right to left, partially blurred due to motion. Their face is partially visible, and they appear to be browsing products. They are positioned between shelves of instant noodles and other goods.

objects.label: instant noodle cups
objects.observation: Rows of brightly colored instant noodle cups fill multiple shelves, arranged by color and brand. Visible brands include UGO. The cups are stacked neatly, creating a vibrant pattern against the gray walls. Some are obscured by the person walking past.

objects.label: fluorescent lights
objects.observation: Long fluorescent tubes hang from the ceiling, providing bright illumination. They are positioned above the aisles and slightly out of focus due to camera motion blur. Their light reflects off the shelves and products below.

objects.label: hot air balloon decoration
objects.observation: A blue-and-white striped hot air balloon decoration hangs from the ceiling near the center of the frame. It is slightly out of focus and positioned above the middle shelf of instant noodles.

objects.label: beverage bottles
objects.observation: A stack of dark-colored beverage bottles with yellow caps sits on a lower shelf to the right. The bottles are partially obscured by a white product display unit. Branding is visible but blurry.

objects.label: product display unit
objects.observation: A white, upright product display unit stands on the right side of the aisle, holding packaged items. It partially blocks the view of the beverage bottles behind it. Its base rests on the floor, and its top extends toward the ceiling.

<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "thud_dense_test50/image-000039", "image_size": [960, 540], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
